answers.question: Why did Line 2's machines break down?
answers.cypher:
MATCH (w:WorkOrder)-[:PERFORMED_ON]->(m:Machine)-[:PART_OF]->(:Line {name: 'Line 2'})
WHERE w.kind = 'breakdown'
OPTIONAL MATCH (w)-[:CAUSED_BY]->(f:Fault)
RETURN w.id AS work_order, m.name AS machine, w.title AS title, f.description AS fault
ORDER BY work_order
answers.answer: Line 2 had two breakdowns. CNC-04 (WO-2031) stopped with spindle vibration, caused by a worn spindle bearing that had passed its service interval. Lathe-02 (WO-2038) had a chuck pressure fault, caused by a sticking pneumatic valve on the chuck supply.

answers.question: Which suppliers' components keep failing?
answers.cypher:
MATCH (w:WorkOrder)-[:INVOLVED]->(c:Component)
RETURN c.name AS component, count(w) AS work_orders
ORDER BY work_orders DESC, component
answers.answer: The graph does not record suppliers, so I can't say whose components keep failing. It does record the components each work order touched: 17 different components, none of them in more than one work order.
